lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT Page 80 Complaint No. 05-0157-955 File Number

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. Anything else?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: The wood cabinet and the van seat.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. But after you put her on the fire and you put all the stuff on top of her, what do you do next?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: We waited until most of its burned and then he swishes it around.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How does he swish it around?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: With a shovel and

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: A rake.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And you helped him with that, right.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. Tell me what you did.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I was just movin' the ashes and that around.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Were you choppin' up the bones?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Who was doing that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He was.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Well, show me how he was doin' that.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He would take the shovel and like bang on the, the bones.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And you did that too?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well, I was just swishing the ashes around.
